pearl_education.title: Pearl: Education Kits
pearl_education.scope: Pearl frames SK/PK/PL as educational kits for beginning percussionists. Manufacturer claim, not school mandate.

pearl_sk.title: Pearl: SK910 / SK910C Student Snare Kit
pearl_sk.scope: 14x5.5 steel snare, 14-inch practice pad, stand, sticks and carrying case.

pearl_pk.title: Pearl: PK910 / PK910C Bell Kit
pearl_pk.scope: 2.5-octave F5-C8 bells, tunable pad, stand, rack, sticks and mallets.

pearl_pl.title: Pearl: PL910C Percussion Learning Center
pearl_pl.scope: Combined student kit with a 13-inch wood snare, 2.5-octave bells, practice pad, rack, sticks, mallets and wheeled case. The snare depth is not asserted.
pearl_pl.limitations: The same manufacturer page gives 13x3 inches in its main component table and 13x3.5 inches in Features. This is an unresolved source discrepancy, not evidence of separate generations. Confirm the supplied drum against the actual kit documentation.

yamaha_yx2035.title: Yamaha: YX-2035PR Student Xylophone
yamaha_yx2035.scope: 3.5-octave Pao Rosa student xylophone, 1.5-inch bars and gas-spring height adjustment.

yamaha_launch.title: Yamaha: YX-2035PR successor to YX-135
yamaha_launch.scope: Yamaha identifies YX-2035PR as successor to popular YX-135 for beginner/intermediate students.

yamaha_yx135_us.title: Yamaha: YX-135
yamaha_yx135_us.scope: YX-135 described for limited budgets, beginning percussionists and educators.

yamaha_yx135_ru.title: Yamaha Россия: YX-135
yamaha_yx135_ru.scope: Russian product page documents 3.5-octave Padauk model; it does not prove current Russian stock.

yamaha_yx135_eu.title: Yamaha Europe: YX-135 discontinued
yamaha_yx135_eu.scope: European Yamaha marks YX-135 discontinued. Used to bound legacy status.

adams_xylo.title: Adams: Academy Series Xylophone
adams_xylo.scope: 3.5-octave entry-level xylophone for young musicians with portable adjustable stand and case.

adams_marimba.title: Adams: Academy Series Marimba
adams_marimba.scope: 3.0/3.3-octave student marimbas for school/home use, adjustable stands and Padouk bars.

kazan_xylo.title: ДМШ им. Дж. Файзи: программа «Ксилофон»
kazan_xylo.scope: Municipal music-school program documents xylophone as a multi-year specialty.

russian_exam.title: ДШИ: программа духовых и ударных — ксилофон и малый барабан
russian_exam.scope: Program examples pair a xylophone work with a snare-drum work for percussion examinations; curriculum evidence, not model recommendation.

distinctions: Pearl SK, PK and PL solve different education configurations and are not ranked as one mandatory route.
YX-135 is marked legacy/discontinued in Europe; YX-2035PR is the current successor.
Russian curriculum confirms xylophone/snare educational roles, not Pearl/Yamaha/Adams model recommendations.
Adjustable height is a quality-led criterion independent of brand.
Public pages do not claim ONTOS.RENT stock.
PL910C snare depth remains unresolved because two sections of the manufacturer page disagree; only the 13-inch diameter is retained.
The Adams Academy height range 77-97 cm applies to MSLD33W, not automatically to both Academy marimba configurations.
Fixed working height is checked against the individual player; adulthood does not establish ergonomic suitability.

second_pass.scope: All ten existing pages: Russian public language, distinct learning tasks, reasons for temporary access and bounded technical claims. Routes, subject count and navigation are preserved.
second_pass.retrieval_limits: Yamaha direct page opens returned HTTP 403; indexed official Yamaha results supported the successor, gas-spring adjustment and European discontinued status. Russian school PDFs remain prior evidence; this pass does not claim to have re-read them.
second_pass.editorial_inferences: Suggested comparison exercises, rehearsal duration and checks of the actual rental kit are editorial applications to the task, not a mandatory teaching method or manufacturer guarantee.
